early.name: Stalker
early.annotation: Illegal damage in lane, very strong. DoT + Shred and bonus move speed.

early.name: Cultist Sacrifice
early.annotation: PvE option to keep economy up. Preferable when you can't get a lead in lane or enemy early game is stronger for one reason or another.

mid.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
mid.annotation: Very strong item to hit investment spikes with, gives bullet resist, shred, and damage.

mid.name: Spirit Snatch
mid.annotation: Big burst + spirit power and resist STEAL. OP item all the time.

mid.name: Healbane
mid.annotation: can buy instead of trophy collector very good too i just like trophy for movespeed and money

mid.name: Dispel Magic
mid.annotation: Great item with a nice spirit resist bonus stat. Removing debuffs as the frontliner is OP and will save your life and maintain your pressure in fights.

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: i have not been prioritizing this early but insane buy if/when you think you need to just throw out your 1 a lot

late.name: Greater Expansion
late.annotation: Makes your Bashdown and Chain Gang pretty massive, item feels good to use.

late.name: Colossus
late.annotation: Fat HP increase + insane resists and more weapon damage. Very good on Billy right now due to his extremely high HP per boon.

late.name: Plated Armor
late.annotation: Very good item against characters applying a ton of on-hit bullet effects. Better when you already have some bullet/debuff resist and if you're ahead.

late.name: Witchmail
late.annotation: With Witchmail you can have max Rising Ram off cooldown almost all the time, allowing you to drop max %HP bombs on targets in rapid succession.

late.name: Unstoppable
late.annotation: If there's an extremely high number of CC having this item is very strong to stay active and have your attacks unimpeded. Does NOT stop on-hit bullet effects, despite the item description.

2108215830.annotation: [Swap] for Crushing or RR. This item does not stack if you team has it. Very good item as it gives your WHOLE team bullet resistance! and on active gives firerate + Movement speed! !

3585132399.annotation: (You can go this instead of Colossus if you want to be active on the map) Sell in late game for Colossus. Really good item that has you perma on the map, giving you some extra hp

3140772621.annotation: Weaker metal skin but it has no active and it's green, Only good if you have 4 active items and can't buy metal skin

3361075077.annotation: Could be very good in lane. It is up every wave fight around this. Good vs graves skulls. Pref vs more gun favored enemies to benefit from bullet res.

2533252781.annotation: Do NOT sleep on E-shift. If there are way too many spells / ults that will straight up cause you to lose all momentum and die having I-frames on demand is OP.

1250307611.annotation: [UPGRADE] Great VS a lot of slows and also fast fire rate characters | Also great slot locked upgrade (Had no room, this is an upgrade not swappable :) )

3028234315.annotation: With Witchmail you can have max Rising Ram off cooldown almost all the time, allowing you to drop max %HP bombs on targets in rapid succession.

1955841979.annotation: Great item now with the build path and changes, now gives you 25% debuff resist

2820116164.annotation: Anti-Burst, ult to have the resistances on top of everything, better than spellbreaker

2519598785.annotation: This is more of a Late game purchase when you have items like scourge, alch fire, RR + Crushing (Ultra late game)

1378931225.annotation: Immune to bullets for a bit

2037039379.annotation: Antiheal + helps vs characters that apply unavoidable high DoT DPS like Abrams or Viktor

339443430.annotation: INSANE for debuff + fire rate. this should be your 2nd or 3rd T4 purchase (or whenever needed)

1282141666.annotation: BUY 1st IF ENEMY BUYING TOO MUCH GREENS OR IF THEYRE TOO TANKY. INSANE FOR SUSTAIN AND GUN DMG

343572757.annotation: Rising Ram drops nuclear bombs and procs this very reliably. Expensive but my favorite antiheal source right now due to its AoE effect.

1113837674.annotation: Give you spirit resistance + your Bashdown (1) Procs the Spirit Damage Reduction in an AOE. Really good into spirit heavy comps!!

3884003354.annotation: good against lots of tanky healers

3357231760.annotation: This is one of the best items in the game. Go this if enemy has a lot of ways of punishing you for going in / CC. Silences, Curse, Doorman, stuns, etc.

951866250.annotation: Raahhhhh.... go this if you go reactive barrier and the enemy team has a lot of cc (Mo ult, wraith ult, door man ult) + refund time on cooldowns (THIS IS AUTO COUNTERSPELL on 55s cooldown)

805079544.annotation: Nice barrier that is easy to use and gives resists for a short while.

4204808176.annotation: Always check what item the opponents build, If they buy Rebuttal early you are forced to play the game very differently, you can only hit 3 light melee vs rebuttal instead of 4-5 light melee

2481177645.annotation: Big bullet resist shred on alone targets, and bullet resist shred around people in general. Think of it as the evil version of Heroic Aura that lets you debuff the enemy team instead.

1252627263.annotation: Not very good, it needs to scale and at that point there are better items out there

1932939246.annotation: Does ramping damage & shreds bullet resist. Can force people to stand in it with Rising Ram & Chain Gang. VERY STRONG for rift/mid-boss.

3074274290.annotation: [SWAP ENDURING SPEED] if you are roaming around a lot and getting a lot of kills + enemy doesnt have much slows you can replace this with enduring speed

26002154.annotation: i usually buy melee charge + lifestrike together later once walkers are gone and the timing is right

787198704.annotation: i have not been prioritizing this early but insane buy if/when you think you need to just throw out your 1 a lot

2142980412.annotation: Spirit Sap upgrade, Not good imo because it gets counterbought by dispel magic, very strong if nobody bought it though

395944548.annotation: [SWAP] For Rapid Recharge. - Consistent spirit damage (Have to be in close proximity of enemy).

1152158042.annotation: Sets up your ult, or can better guarantee kills off of it |

1292979587.annotation: Sell extra regen for this | Gives your ram more spirit damage. Can be replaced with slowing hex if your team really needs it.. or Bullet Resist Shredder for a cheap boost in damage.

1414319208.annotation: (TLDR more more damage) This item is really good and is pumping damage out | Take Any Damage = Stack = More Weapon Damage up to 70%!! Super good since we will be perma fighting and more tanky now!!!

3403085434.annotation: [SWAP] for Slowing Bullets. This item is has buffed %Weapon damage + Slow Resist, help with urn rotations early (Very good item) | Helps with 4.8k gun spike early

84321454.annotation: Flat damage on Bashdown and DPS increase. Build path into Merc Mag.

1548066885.annotation: More DPS + builds into Escalating Resilience.

1254091416.annotation: Channel ults like Bebop's Hyper Beam and McGinnis' Heavy Barrage can get shut down with Knockdown and Knockdown poops on fliers.

619484391.annotation: Very strong item, take this to make your enemies feel helpless.

865958998.annotation: Better uptime and stats than Fortitude. This item is overstatted and very OP.

1925087134.annotation: Lowers enemy fire rate and also gives bullet resist stat. Very good when coupled with another bullet resist item.

3919289022.annotation: SECRET CHINESE TECHNOLOGY !!!! If you can avoid reloading by using Blasted melee damage reloads you will permanently have the bonus bullet damage. Very big bonus damage.

2717651715.annotation: Makes Bashdown knock-up last longer, your ram go for miles, Blasted last forever, and Chain Gang unstop last a long time. Boosts all your items as well. Very strong item.

668299740.annotation: Helps weave in more shots between each heavy melee when jungling and helps hit 4.8k gun spike, sell for slot later

1710079648.annotation: low on hp in lane or need more health before 8:00 for sinners, you can go catch boxes while you heal so the enemy team doens't take it off of you

2462046703.annotation: Buy in guaranteed lose lanes (Bad Synergy + Bad Matchup) so you can catch up for the loss, Pop during 1.3k souls on Egg

600033864.annotation: If you see the enemy team bunch up a lot, this with Chain gang is an awesome engage tool, Try it on Testing lab before hand to get a feel

1662311306.annotation: VS Pocket Affliction, It's close to impossible to counterspell it, if he is the team's carry

380806748.annotation: Useful with higher ult cooldowns being a global hero crisis, For more teamfight utility, billy has no need to upgrade it later

1219329868.annotation: Can help into lanes with annoying percistent DoT like Shiv daggers or something else of similar nature, also upgrades into focus lens

3791587546.annotation: buy this when you sell stalker
